results.title: Worcester City Pride returns with spooky-themed celebration for 2026
results.description: Worcester City Pride returned to St Andrew’s Methodist Church on October 10 for Spooky Pride, featuring drag, workshops, stalls and community support.

results.title: Saturday Sessions: Christone "Kingfish" Ingram performs "Bad Like Me"
results.description: Grammy Award-winning guitarist and singer-songwriter Christone "Kingfish" Ingram brings Mississippi blues tradition to his captivating live performances. Kingfish has played with everyone from Vampire Weekend to Gary Clark Jr. and contributed to the score for the Oscar-winning movie "Sinners." Kingfish's latest album, "Hard Road," is described as his "most sophisticated and musically ambitious collection yet." Here's Kingfish with "Bad Like Me."

results.title: Palace unsettled as Prince Harry paid massive sum for talking about grieving Diana
